verdict.rationale: Jules is designed around natural-language task submission and messaging: users submit a task description, Jules generates a plan, and you can send follow-up messages to the agent via API or web app (jules-docs-4, jules-docs-12). Community reports confirm real-world use of NL prompts to drive coding tasks, including iterative feedback and error-message follow-ups (jules-comm-2, jules-comm-15, jules-comm-16). Missing for 10: no detailed documentation of the full range/complexity of natural-language commands supported (e.g., multi-step conversational control, command reference) and no independent benchmark of NL command robustness beyond anecdotal reports.
